# ICC policy references

Synthetic v4 RGB/Lab profiles generated by `scripts/generate-icc-policy-reference.py`. Expected pixels come from LittleCMS 2.19's public `cmsCreateTransform` and `cmsDoTransform` ABI, using intent codes 0–3, `cmsFLAGS_COPY_ALPHA | cmsFLAGS_NOOPTIMIZE`, and the explicit BPC flag. NOOPTIMIZE evaluates the profile stages directly rather than an approximate composite LUT; optimized outputs are retained separately as diagnostic evidence. RGB tolerance remains 8 UInt16 codes; alpha is exact. The corpus also contains synthetic RGB/Gray matrix/TRC v2/v4 profiles, including a non-D50 v4 absolute-colorimetric case. The nonuniform mAB CLUT is 2×3×4; its A2B3 tag is retained as an ignored fixed-point absolute-intent control. The one-point grid is a negative case for the library's 2–65-point contract. No installed or vendor profile is included. `--check` is read-only.
